newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BOURSE OKS ASPIS PRONIA SHARE CAP.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BOURSE OKS ASPIS PRONIA SHARE CAP.

text.p: Athens bourse has approved the share capital increase of Aspis Pronia Insurance , it said in a statement.
The insurance firm will raise 2.564 billion drachmas by issuing 3.92 million new registered shares at a face value of 100 drachmas, it said.
The proceeds will be used to finance the firm's working capital needs and the construction of new buildings.
Old shareholders will be entitled to one new share per 8.9 existing, common or preferred, ones for 2,563,664 new shares. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
